Follow the live quest objective marker. Defeat Chillmaw and the three Cultist Bombardiers, checking both objective counters. Group up if needed; the guide does not infer solo capability from level.
Return to the quest giver with both objectives finished. Choose the writ or purse yourself. The base seals and optional opened purse are separate yields.

recovery.text: Check the live quest marker and both counters. A missing dragon sighting is not a kill or a completed daily; wait, look for a group or defer this activity.
